name: Ethoxylated decyl alcohol phosphate potassium salt
description: Ethoxylated decyl alcohol phosphate potassium salt (CAS 68070-99-5 ) is an anionic surfactant combining phosphate ester chemistry with ethoxylated fatty alcohol. It delivers effective wetting, emulsification, and detergency across industrial and consumer formulations. Its potassium salt form ensures good water solubility and compatibility with alkaline process conditions. In textile and leather processing, it functions as a wetting and scouring agent, improving fiber penetration during dyeing and finishing operations. Industrial and institutional cleaning formulations use it as a degreasing surfactant in hard surface cleaners and metal cleaning compounds. It is also highly effective in alkaline detergent concentrates for heavy-duty applications. In personal care, it serves as an emulsifier and cleansing agent in rinse-off products where mild anionic character is required. Paper manufacturing applies it as a dispersant and surface modifier to improve fiber wetting. It is also used to enhance coating adhesion during sheet formation in the paper industry. This product is typically supplied as a liquid or paste, depending on the specific ethoxylation degree and concentration required. Technical grade is the standard commercial form for industrial cleaning and textile applications. Higher-purity grades are available for personal care formulations to meet specific industry requirements and safety profiles. Bulk supply is common in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes. This ensures consistent availability for large-scale manufacturing and chemical processing facilities worldwide.
